textSegments: Complies with ATX12 v2.5 & EPS12 v2.92
HEXA 85+ Pro Series, 80 PLUS ® bronze certified, saves energy through its high efficiency up to 85%.
It gives your system a superior look than any other entry level power supplies.
Stable DC to DC Output Quality

HEXA85+ PRO series applies DC to DC modules to improve the reliability for greater compatibility as well as low ripple noise to reduce interference of system components for a prolonged system lifetime.
Designed for power-intensive VGA cards, no problems to any overloading condition.
HEXA 85+ PRO series comes with a 120mm quiet fan and a highly efficient ventilation fan guard to guarantee low noise operations without compromising its cooling efficiency.
Japanese  electrolytic capacitors ensures safety on spare parts for prolonged lifespan and reliability.
For gaming enthusiast, the HEXA 85+ PRO 650W featured dual CPU power connectors for high-end motherboards and stable CPU power delivery.
Green Power! The total AC power consumption less than 5Vsb rail to meet the new EU Regulation ErP 2013 for modern systems.
